Connected Hearts. Each Sora carries its own keyblade, including mid-room changes from the menu. Magic is selectable again in the command menu. The other player's Sora no longer shows in your pause menu, so you can't edit their equipment or abilities. Launcher: Steam names and pictures for recent players, a Paste button for SteamIDs, and Connect waits until your save is loaded. Fixes several crashes when changing keyblades.
